description_en: Retrieves the list of servers that support vulnerability fixing based on vulnerability names
description_zh: 根据漏洞名称获取支持修复的机器列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-uuids-by-vul-names --type cve --vul-names centos:8:rhsa-2020:1665 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUuidsByVulNames

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The type of vulnerability to query. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞类型。取值：

cve：Linux软件漏洞
sys：Windows系统漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Separate multiple statuses with commas (,). Valid values:

1: unfixed
2: fix failed
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞的修复状态。多个修复状态使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

1：未修复
2：修复失败
parameters.name: status_list

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability level. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

high: high
medium: medium
low: low
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞等级。多个漏洞等级使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

high：高危
medium：中危
low：低危
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the vulnerability has been handled. Valid values:
y: handled
n: not handled
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞是否处理。取值：
y：已处理
n：未处理
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of VPC-connected instances to query for vulnerabilities. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询漏洞的VPC实例ID。多个ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: vpc_instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The asset information for the vulnerability query. You can set this parameter to the asset name, public IP address, or private IP address. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询漏洞的资产信息，可以设置为资产名称、公网IP或私网IP（支持模糊查询）
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The query type. Valid values:

containerId: container ID
uuid: asset ID
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型。取值：

containerId：容器ID
uuid：资产ID
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The priority level of vulnerability fixing. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

asap: high
later: medium
nntf: low
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞修复必要性等级。多个等级用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

asap：高
later：中
nntf：低
parameters.name: necessity

parameters.help_en:
The collection of vulnerability names.
You can call the [DescribeGroupedVul](~~DescribeGroupedVul~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞名称集合。
您可调用[DescribeGroupedVul](~~DescribeGroupedVul~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: vul_names

MachineInfoStatistics.description_en: The list of asset statistics information

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the associated instance

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the associated instance

MachineInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the server

MachineIp.description_en: The IP address of the server

Os.description_en: The operating system name of the server
Os.description_zh: 服务器的操作系统名称

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

VulCount.description_en: The total number of vulnerabilities on the server
VulCount.description_zh: 服务器的漏洞的总数量
